question: Which footedness label does FM show for each managed first-team player, obtained from FM's own property getter with no player screen open?
limitations: Scope is the managed first team, where the manager has full knowledge; external players need the scouted-person path and are not supported.
FM code is executed on its UI thread inside a QueryPerformanceCounter hook; use the disposable research save.
Only FM's five visible footedness categories are reported; the underlying foot ratings never leave FM.
